title: Phones in the Classroom
text:
Many students have phones in their bags. Some teachers think phones are useful for learning. For example, students can look up new words quickly. In my opinion, phones should be allowed in class for research only.

However, phones can also be a distraction. Students often check messages during lessons. Because of this, many schools have strict rules. I believe that clear rules are better than a total ban.

questions.text: According to paragraph one, how can students use phones for learning?
options: They can look up new words quickly
They can watch films all day

questions.text: According to paragraph two, what do students often do during lessons?
What can the reader infer about schools that have strict phone rules?
options: They worry that phones take students' attention
They want students to buy more phones
They do not care about lessons
They never allow books in class

questions.text: What does the writer probably think about a total phone ban?
options: It is not the best solution
It should be used in all schools forever
It is only useful for teachers

vocabulary.definition: helpful or good for a purpose
something that takes your attention away from what you are doing
requiring people to obey rules exactly
careful study to find out information

paragraph_translations: Birçok öğrencinin çantasında telefonu var. Bazı öğretmenler telefonların öğrenme için yararlı olduğunu düşünüyor. Örneğin öğrenciler yeni kelimelere hızlıca bakabilir. Bence telefonlara derste sadece araştırma için izin verilmeli.

Ancak telefonlar dikkat dağıtıcı da olabilir. Öğrenciler derslerde sık sık mesajlarına bakıyor. Bu yüzden birçok okulda katı kurallar var. Bence açık kurallar, telefonların tamamen yasaklanmasından daha iyidir.
